purpose: Prompt pack for generating orderly Terraria-style pixel item atlases. Generate each page as a complete grid, then crop by cell.

output_recommendation.post_crop_target: Crop each cell, trim transparent/chroma-key margin, then downscale or pixel-resample to the desired tModLoader item texture size, usually 32x32, 40x40, 48x48, or 64x64 depending on weapon length.
output_recommendation.background: Prefer true transparent PNG if the model supports it. If not, use a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background and remove it after generation.

global_prompt: Create a clean Terraria mod item sprite atlas: pixel art fantasy equipment icons, crisp 2D orthographic view, transparent background or perfectly flat #00ff00 chroma-key background, 4 columns by 4 rows, each sprite centered inside its own equally sized cell, generous empty padding around every sprite, no overlap between cells, no shadows on the background, no labels, no numbers, no text, no UI frame, no inventory slot border. Each item must be a single complete isolated icon with readable silhouette at small size, strong outline, limited palette, high contrast highlights, and a consistent top-left light source. Keep long weapons diagonal from lower-left to upper-right unless the item description says otherwise. Keep books, tablets, seals, shields, and charms front-facing and centered.
negative_prompt: no text, no captions, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no character holding the item, no hands, no scenery, no inventory boxes, no grid lines drawn over the sprites, no perspective scene, no 3D render, no blurry edges, no photorealism, no duplicated objects within one cell, no cropped-off tips, no overlapping cells, no green pixels in the item if using #00ff00 chroma key

style_reference.medium: Terraria-like pixel item icon, fantasy modded weapon sprite
style_reference.rendering: low-resolution pixel art, hand-painted clusters, strong black or dark colored outline, bright specular edge pixels, readable silhouette
style_reference.composition: one centered object per cell, consistent scale across the page

single_item_prompt_template: Create one Terraria-style pixel art item icon on transparent or flat #00ff00 background: {{cell_prompt}} Use crisp low-resolution pixel art, strong outline, top-left highlights, readable silhouette, centered with generous padding, no text, no watermark, no character, no inventory slot frame.
notes_for_generation: Use the page prompts when you want consistent style and easy row-column cropping.
If the model struggles with exact grid placement, generate one page at a time and restate that each cell must contain exactly one complete item.
If the model adds labels, strengthen the negative prompt with: absolutely no text, no captions, no letters, no numbers anywhere.
If using chroma key, keep #00ff00 out of the sprites and remove it after generation.
For long weapons, crop with extra margin first, then trim transparent pixels manually so blade tips are not clipped.
